caseNameFull: Dew v. Halaby, Administrator, Federal Aviation Agency
attorneys: David Rein and Joseph Forer for petitioner. Solicitor General Cox, Assistant Attorney General Douglas and Sherman L. Cohn for respondents.

opinions.text: Motion for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and petition for writ of cer-tiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit granted. Case transferred to the appellate docket.
